_meta.status: PLACEHOLDER — NOT PARTNER-VALIDATED. Every entry below is a generic, widely-published adult reference interval / panic threshold from standard clinical chemistry literature, not reviewed or signed off by a design-partner lab. Design-partner sign-off is tracked as an open follow-up issue, not yet satisfied. Do not treat these values as clinically authoritative for a real report.
